The claim, brought by the American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice, argued that an Indiana law “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” Judge Christina R. [...] The post This Judge Thinks Killing Babies in Abortions is a Religious Right appeared first on LifeNews.com .
inputs.modified_text: Have you heard about this? An Indiana judge blocked a prolife law earlier this month, arguing that limiting abortion violates freedom of religion. The ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice pushed the claim that the law “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” This is clearly coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions using the courts to twist religious freedom into a tool for keeping abortion going. They're inverting the whole thing to block any real protections for life, and the official excuses about beliefs are just a cover for their concealed agenda to maintain control through these groups.
